attributes.action: Fund all schools nationwide to implement Air conditioning in all classrooms.
attributes.additional_details: This petition is a pledge to the government of our country to implement nation wide Air Conditioning units in schools to help the students learn nicer in this 30+ degree weather we appear to be having during the summers.
attributes.background: Heat kills. If you want the best out of the students of your country, your future politicians, your future NHS workers, your future teachers, etc... then we need to tackle the ever growing heat crisis by implementing Air Conditioning to keep the temperatures at optimal conditions.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Legislate a statutory maximum temperature for classrooms and fund school cooling
